info.title: OFFER-HUB Orchestrator API
info.description: Generated from the real orchestrator controllers and DTOs - see scripts/openapi-source-data.ts and scripts/README.md for how.

servers.description: Production - replace the placeholder with your deployed orchestrator domain

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Create and list API keys, exchange a key for a short-lived token, and read the current auth context.

tags.name: Config & Health
tags.description: Public endpoints needing no credential: platform configuration and basic/detailed health checks.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Order lifecycle up to escrow funding, plus milestone bookkeeping inside IN_PROGRESS.

tags.name: Escrow
tags.description: Smart contract creation and funding for a funded order, deployed through Trustless Work.

tags.name: Resolution
tags.description: Settles a funded escrow: release to seller, refund to buyer, or open a dispute.

tags.name: Disputes
tags.description: List, inspect, assign, and resolve disputes raised on escrowed orders.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Create users with an automatic balance, and link a user's Airtm account.

tags.name: Wallet & Top-ups
tags.description: Stellar wallet info, crypto deposit instructions, transaction history, and AirTM top-up flow.

tags.name: Balance
tags.description: Atomic ledger balance operations scoped to a user, backed by Prisma transactions and audit logging.

tags.name: Withdrawals
tags.description: Payout operations from a user's ledger balance to a bank account, crypto address, or AirTM balance, via AirTM payouts or direct Stellar transfers.

tags.name: Audit Logs
tags.description: Query the marketplace audit trail with filters and cursor pagination. Requires the support scope.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Real-time domain event stream over Server-Sent Events (SSE).

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Inbound webhook receivers that external providers (AirTM, Trustless Work) call to notify the Orchestrator. Not an outbound subscription API — integrators use the SSE event stream instead.

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream of domain events (DomainEvent envelope: eventId, eventType, occurredAt, aggregateId, aggregateType, payload, metadata), scoped to the marketplace bound to the caller's API key. Sends a 'ping' heartbeat every 30 seconds. Supports reconnection via the Last-Event-ID header (exclusive replay from Redis, capped at the last 1000 events) or the since query param. This is NOT a JSON response — it is a text/event-stream, unlike every other endpoint in this API.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: Missing or invalid API key

parameters.description: Repeatable. Exact aggregate type(s) to include (e.g. Order, Balance).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Replays buffered events after this time when no Last-Event-ID header is supplied; the header takes precedence over this param.

post.description: Receives pay-in (topup.*) and pay-out (withdrawal.*) status updates from AirTM. Signature verification runs first (Svix headers + AIRTM_WEBHOOK_SECRET); an invalid signature is rejected with 401 before any processing. Duplicate deliveries (same provider+eventId) are acknowledged and skipped. Responses are always 200 after a valid signature, even for business-logic failures, to avoid provider retry storms.

200.description: Processed for the first time / Duplicate delivery / Valid signature, business failure (e.g. related top-up not found)

variant3.summary: Valid signature, business failure (e.g. related top-up not found)

401.description: WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID: Invalid or missing Svix signature headers (the AirTM page's own response table just says 'standard error envelope' without naming a code; this is the matching global catalog code per errors.mdx, which explicitly covers 'inbound Svix or HMAC signature failed cryptographic verification')

error.message: Invalid or missing Svix signature headers (the AirTM page's own response table just says 'standard error envelope' without naming a code; this is the matching global catalog code per errors.mdx, which explicitly covers 'inbound Svix or HMAC signature failed cryptographic verification')

post.description: Receives escrow lifecycle events from Trustless Work (escrow.created, escrow.funding_started, escrow.funded, escrow.milestone_completed, escrow.released, escrow.refunded, escrow.disputed) and flips the escrow/order state machines, re-emitting the corresponding domain events on the SSE stream. Events carrying a transaction_hash are verified against the Stellar network before the state change is applied.

200.description: Processed for the first time / Duplicate delivery (not re-applied; still reports processed: true)

variant2.summary: Duplicate delivery (not re-applied; still reports processed: true)

401.description: WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID: x-tw-signature header present but does not match HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, TRUSTLESS_WEBHOOK_SECRET)

error.message: x-tw-signature header present but does not match HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, TRUSTLESS_WEBHOOK_SECRET)

code.description: Canonical machine-readable error code. Branch on this field, not on message.

message.description: Human-readable explanation; may change across versions.

buyerId.description: Internal buyer user ID with the usr_ prefix.

sellerId.description: Internal seller user ID with the usr_ prefix.

amount.description: Decimal string with exactly two places, e.g. "100.00".

clientOrderRef.description: Your own unique order reference; practical idempotency key.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON. metadata.platformFee overrides the default 5% platform fee.

milestones.description: Sub-deliverables; amounts must sum exactly to amount.

ref.description: Marketplace milestone reference, used in the complete path.

reason.description: Free text recorded on the audit entry. Optional; omit the body entirely to send none.
Free-text reason recorded in the audit log; body itself is optional.
Non-empty reason for the refund; required.

orderId.description: Required by the DTO even though the service uses the path parameter.

order.description: Present when relations are included; has nested escrow and milestones

refundAmount.description: Buyer portion; required when decision=SPLIT. @Matches(/^\d+\.\d{2}$/). releaseAmount + refundAmount must equal the order amount exactly.

externalUserId.description: Your marketplace's own ID for this user; unique platform-wide.

email.description: Must match the email registered in Airtm.

amount.description: Decimal string with exactly 2 decimals, regex ^\d+\.\d{2}$.

reserved.description: Locked for orders reserved but not yet funded into escrow.

amount.description: Decimal string with exactly 2 decimal places (validated by AMOUNT_REGEX).

sellerId.description: User ID receiving the released funds.

providerVerified.description: true only when synced and no discrepancy action was needed.

userId.description: Internal user ID performing the withdrawal.

amount.description: Decimal string with exactly 2 decimal places.

currency.description: Defaults to "USD"; currently the only supported value.

destinationRef.description: Bank account ID, Stellar address, or AirTM balance ref depending on destinationType.

commit.description: If true, create and commit in one step. Defaults to false (two-step).

note.description: Same shape as Get Withdrawal's response.

DomainEventStreamMessage.description: Not JSON — a raw SSE wire message. Each message's 'data' line is JSON matching the DomainEvent<T> shape: {eventId, eventType, occurredAt, aggregateId, aggregateType, payload, metadata}. A heartbeat 'ping' event (no eventId) is sent every 30s and should be ignored as a domain event.

data.description: The affected pay-in/pay-out; data.id maps the event to a topup/withdrawal
amount is expressed in stroops; contract_id is the Stellar escrow contract address matched to trustlessContractId
